children: FAST RETAILING CO., LTD. (TSE:9983) posted FY revenue ¥3.963T and strong profits as international sales hit ¥2.4T while North America/Europe topped Greater China, but warned a weak yen and rising import costs could cloud Q4 and prompt price hikes amid global expansion and new flagships.
FAST RETAILING 9983 FY Revenue, Profit Guidance
: FAST RETAILING (9983): FY revenue ¥3.963T, operating profit ¥743.1B (+32% YoY), net income ¥542.5B (+25%). International sales ¥2.4T. FY2027 guidance: revenue ¥4.45T, op profit ¥830B.
FAST RETAILING 9983 HK Depositary Receipts Halted
: FAST RETAILING (9983) said trading of its Hong Kong-listed depositary receipts was halted on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange at 1:00 PM on October 8, 2026.
FAST RETAILING 9983 Yen Hit, Expansion Plans
: FAST RETAILING (9983) warned a weak yen and rising import costs may hurt fourth-quarter results and spur price hikes. Founder Tadashi Yanai plans global expansion with more flagship stores.
: FAST RETAILING (9983): North America and Europe revenue ¥877.6B, exceeding Greater China ¥724.0B—first time Western markets topped Greater China in reported sales.
: FAST RETAILING (9983): North America and Europe offset weak China; Uniqlo store growth boosts results. Plans ~20 flagship stores in Japan over decade and shifts to larger, multi‑floor formats.
: FAST RETAILING (9983): Uniqlo Japan Q4 sales down ~4% due to below-normal temperatures, typhoons and extended rain, weakening consumer demand.
: FAST RETAILING (9983) opens its eighth Spain store in Madrid’s Argüelles at Princesa 65. Flagship spans ~1,700 sqm, among Spain’s largest Uniqlo locations; includes a 400 sqm restaurant.
